variants.name: full
variants.description: Learned attention, path membership, timing depth, and edge features.

variants.name: no_attention
variants.description: Incoming driver messages use equal weights.

variants.name: no_path_membership
variants.description: The reported-path membership channel is zero. Depth channels stay.

variants.name: no_timing_criticality
variants.description: Logic depth and source distance are zero. Path membership stays.

variants.name: no_edge_features
variants.description: Edge channels are zero. Attention still uses node and timing state.

note: Endpoint metrics use published path-table slack. Path membership is timing column 1. Timing criticality is logic depth and source distance.
